code_findings.finding: A page_context row speaks for a property class (all/tensile/flexural/impact/thermal/physical) of a whole page, not for one table. A statement that heads only one table is inherited by every row of that class on the page, including rows from a different table that does not carry it.
code_findings.evidence: PC00041 (data/tables/page_context.csv:42; I-ESD-ABS-TDS p1, scope thermal, annealed) comes from the heading 'Thermal Properties Standard Test Test Data (After Annealing)', which sits over the heat-distortion rows only. The glass transition 80 C (V000605) is printed under 'Physical Properties Standard Test Test Data' and now compiles as postProcessingState=annealed with pageContext PC00041 (dist/db.json). Only V000605 is hit in the current data (the only non-HDT/Vicat thermal row inheriting a treatment), but the design cannot express a per-table statement.

code_findings.finding: audit:context, the guard that keeps RC3, RC4 and RC8 removed, exits 0 ('skipped') when .cache/text is absent, so CI (Linux, empty cache) never runs it. The README and D116 present it as part of verify; the claim holds only on a contributor checkout.
code_findings.evidence: Line 21: if (!existsSync(cacheDir('text'))) { console.log('audit:context skipped: no text cache ...'); process.exit(0); }. The header comment says 'runs where the cache is (a contributor's checkout) and says so where it is not (CI)'. The baseline context-witness-accepted.csv is therefore not checked in CI either; a stale or new finding cannot fail the pipeline.

code_findings.finding: PARSE-TEXT-BOUNDS accepts any digit string in the cell as a 'stated' number, plus the Fahrenheit conversion of every number and 20/23/25 when 'room/ambient/RT' occurs. It is a necessary check, not a sufficient one: it cannot see the m08 failure it was written for (3 from 'for 3D printers', 24 from 'shelf life of 24 months' are digits the cell contains).
code_findings.evidence: statedNumbers() uses /\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g over the whole raw text and pushes round((x-32)*5/9) for each number. The real protection against the original error is the scoped PARSE-MISMATCH, not PARSE-TEXT-BOUNDS; D115's wording 'a typed endpoint must be a number its own cell prints' overstates what is enforced.

code_findings.finding: Step 2 scopes each of the 147 existing Parse reviews to 'exactly the columns whose stored value still differs from the parser'. This mechanically blesses every existing difference without re-reading whether the review's text explains it; it re-creates, one column at a time, the silencing D115 removes.
code_findings.evidence: m282 later found P0795 (SUNLU ABS-GF bed state 'unknown', scoped to Bed state by m274 although the review explained joined digits, not the state). The sweep states this was the only such case but the 109 other scoped reviews were not individually re-read in the audit trail.

code_findings.finding: PARSE-REVIEW-STALE checks print profiles only; D119 ('a review note that no longer explains anything stops the build') is stated without that limit. Two measurement reviews are stale today. OPEN-PROBLEMS section 28 does disclose the limit.
code_findings.evidence: Replaying applyStateTyped/applyStandardsTyped/applyTestTemperatureTyped on all 19 measurement reviews that name columns: V011542 and V011543 (data/tables/measurements.csv:11543-11544) name 'Test temperature C', which now agrees with the parser (readTestTemperature learned the degree-Celsius glyph in this sweep), so the reviews would silence the next difference.

code_findings.finding: inheritPageContext takes the first matching page_context row per field in file order; an 'all' row and a scoped row with different values on one page would resolve by CSV order, not by specificity. The lint (CONTEXT-ROW-CONTRADICTS-PAGE) compares only specimen, moisture and treatment; a contradicting standard or test temperature is not flagged although D116 says a contradicting row is flagged.
code_findings.evidence: No page in the 88 rows has both 'all' and a scoped row today (checked), so the latent order dependence has no current effect. lint-rules.js lists only [specimen, moisture, treatment] in its loop.

code_findings.finding: AT_LEAST_LEAD_RE types '> 80 C recommended' as an open bound with requirement 'required'; the trailing word 'recommended' is dropped from the requirement (the open-bound branch returns before RECOMMENDED_RE is read). No regression versus before (it was required then too), but the new reader could have kept it.
code_findings.evidence: Line 94-99: the atLeast branch returns requirement: REQUIREMENT.REQUIRED unconditionally.

code_findings.finding: h2cStatusOf promotes every Bambu Lab spool to 'Official Bambu product' regardless of the material's recorded status. 15 active Bambu Lab grades sit under materials recorded as 'Officially listed family' or 'Theoretical' (e.g. G009-01 PLA Silk+ and G010-01 under M008 PLA Silk, 'Theoretical', whose vocabulary meaning is 'Not listed by Bambu'). This is what D118 says, but it contradicts the data for M008.
code_findings.evidence: grades.csv Manufacturer 'Bambu Lab' x42; 15 of them under non-Official materials (G002-01.., G021-01.., G040-01..G043-01, G009-01, G010-01, G001-183).

code_findings.finding: twinsOf orders by 'holds values' first, then same maker by exact manufacturer string equality, then ID. A same-maker twin without measurements loses to another maker's reprint that has them (correct), but 'Spectrum' vs 'Spectrum Filaments' style spellings would defeat the same-maker rule silently.
Orphaned doc comment: the block 'What an UNKNOWN rests on (PM-02)' sits above variantMark, while unknownMark (which it describes) is defined later. Cosmetic.

migration_findings.finding: Wrong page statement. QIDI PA12-CF p3 is the continuation of a two-column Unannealed | Annealed table; the three Z values sit in the Unannealed column (annealed column '/'). The footnote 'Post-processing: 100 C Annealing 8 hours' describes the annealed column. PC00012 (scope all, annealed 100 C / 8 h) makes V009358, V009359, V009360 (G059-02, Z tensile strength 38.61, modulus 2892.15, elongation 1.63) compile as annealed 100/8.
migration_findings.evidence: p2: '未退火 退火后 / Unannealed Annealed' with pairs such as '76.95±1.17 MPa 83.34±0.30 MPa'; p3: '38.61±2.19 MPa /', 'ISO 527 2892.15±46.60 MPa /', '1.63±0.10 % /'. dist/db.json: V009358-60 postProcessingState annealed, pageContext PC00012. The sibling QIDI PET-GF page (PC00085) has a single column and its annealed reading is right.

migration_findings.finding: onSheet() proves only that the quote occurs somewhere in the whole source (all pages joined and stripped to alphanumerics), not on the cited page, near the row, or that it applies to it. The 'guard-checked' claim therefore does not catch a correct quote attached to the wrong rows (as with PC00012 and PC00041).
migration_findings.evidence: texts.set(sourceId, squash(c.pages.map(p => p.lines...join(' ')).join(' '))); includes(squash(q)). The PC00012 quote 'Post-processing : 100C Annealing 8hours' is on the sheet, and passed.

migration_findings.finding: Raw column 'Standard / load' receives words the sheet does not print: V007432 and V011163 '... ASTM 648; ASTM D648', V008886 'HDT A; ISO 75' (sheet: 'ISO-R 75 Method A'), V008914 'ASTM256; ASTM D256', V009856 'ASTM 3418; ASTM D3418'. The normalised name belongs in Standards; AGENTS.md says raw columns keep the source's text and never write a standard the sheet does not print (same standard family, so the reading is right, the raw cell is not verbatim).
migration_findings.evidence: Sheet lines: 'Heat Deflection (ASTM 648, 66 psi)', 'ASTM 3418 145- 160 C', 'Izod ... ASTM256', 'HDT-A ... ISO-R 75 Method A'.

migration_findings.finding: Nine 3DJake profiles get Bed C '+- 35-60 C' (or 60-90/60-100): a fragment of 'If you have a heated bed the recommended temperature is +- 35-60 C'. The qualifiers are dropped, so the parser types the bed window as 'required'; the same sheet says the product 'can also be printed without a heated bed'. No gate effect (within the H2C), but the printing tab will say required.
migration_findings.evidence: P0878 (G008-18): Bed state range 35-60, Bed requirement 'required'; sheet p1: 'can also be printed without a heated bed. If you have a heated bed the recommended temperature is +- 35-60 C.'

migration_findings.finding: 28 impact rows whose unit disagrees with their standard are accepted in bulk with one reason ('the sheet prints it that way'). Seven Extrudr values (V004094 100, V004095 20, V004148/49, V004270/71 kJ/m2 beside ASTM D256) are physically implausible as kJ/m2 (notched 100 > unnotched 20; 220 kJ/m2) and almost surely J/m, while the same family's V004210/V004211 were set 'Unresolved unit / layout' in m280. Inconsistent handling. Headline impact is protected because izodNotched needs ISO 180 (D94), so these show only as related evidence.
migration_findings.evidence: V004094 100 kj/m2 Notched, V004095 20 kj/m2 Unnotched (G033-05), both ASTM D256; Extrudr sheet 'Notched impact strength ASTM D256 kj/m2 100 @ 23C'.

migration_findings.finding: Spectrum FlameGuard ASA 275 (UL 94 V0 flame retardant, density 1080 vs 1070) is put under the plain ASA 275 key because the mechanical tables match. Different formulation; the estimate model now counts them once and each reads the other's values/evidence where its own is silent (D89/D98).
migration_findings.evidence: G031-03 vs G031-15: HDT 86, Izod 435|60, tensile 42, flexural 64/1.9 identical; density 1070 vs 1080; Q02498 'Designed to meet UL 94 V0 standards' exists only on G031-15.

migration_findings.finding: The six LW-PLA-HT rows (V005969-V005974) are typed 'Printed off the product's recipe' from a footnote that says 'printed samples of UNFOAMED PLA-HP', i.e. the base filament PLA-HP, not stated to be this product printed unfoamed. Defensible under D95, but it is an inference beyond the sheet's words.
migration_findings.evidence: Sheet footnote: '*These results are obtained from printed samples of UNFOAMED PLA-HP'; tables headed 'Injection Molded*' and 'Thermal Properties*'.

notes: Scope read: the four commits 5360e2a, da1d280, 5283894, ed6f182 (118 files). No record was removed from any source table (measurements +2, all other tables same row count); every migration edit I read names the value it replaces ('expect') and re-checks a quote on the cached sheet. The 36 spot_check entries (covering about 70 records and statements) read: 32 correct or defensible, 2 wrong (PC00012 for V009358-V009360; PC00041 for V000605) and 2 unclear (P0878 requirement; V004210/V004211 left unresolved). Both wrong cases come from one mechanism: a page_context row is a page-and-class statement, and the migration guard (onSheet) checks a quote exists anywhere in the source, not that it applies to the rows. No finding is high severity; the wrong inheritances touch 4 measurements, none of which is a headline pick I could confirm. Not run (read-only brief): build, verify, snapshot, the UI fuzz. I did not review the 300-scenario fuzz result, snapshot diffs, or UI copy beyond table.js and constraints.js. I did not independently check m275 label renames, the lexicon addition, or the print_guide.csv scoping beyond the m274 logic. The reviewer is an AI; no human reviewed these records.
